learning_outcomes.text: Explain the major political events, periods, and chronological developments of the Ottoman Empire from its foundation to its dissolution.
Analyze the Ottoman state organization, administrative structure, legal system, and social institutions.
Interpret the Ottoman economic structure, land system, trade, and production relations.
Critically evaluate primary and secondary sources related to Ottoman history.
Discuss the cultural, social, and religious diversity of Ottoman history and its effects on the present day.
Research a topic in Ottoman history within the framework of scientific methods and ethical principles, and express it in written and oral form.

syllabus_topics: The Foundation of the Ottoman Empire
General Analysis of the Rise Period
Transformation Age and Characteristics of the Period
II. Siege of Vienna and Events Following
Decline & Modernization Period and Characteristics of the Period
Culture and Civilitazion in Ottoman Empire
bibliography: Erhan Afyoncu, Sorularla Osmanlı İmparatorluğu, 1-6, İstanbul 2004.
Halil İnalcık; Osmanlı İmparatorluğunun Ekonomik ve Sosyal tarihi, I, İstanbul 2000.
